answer: Every attestation is cut like an opal: it embeds a beacon-drawn inclusion that exactly one peer in its witness set must echo this epoch. A missing echo voids the whole attestation cell's standing. Clones farming the swarm expose their karst: shared relay channels, so one post-close audit traces every forged inclusion back to a single seed and burns the cluster. Attacker cost scales with swarm size, not per identity, and each epoch's beacon tide redraws the inclusion space, so a forged echo replayed from a stale epoch voids its own cell.
